## Market-defining technologies driving the future of AI

[Cisco Cloud Control software screenshot]

### Cisco Cloud Control

The unified platform with one shared view across every IT domain.

[Discover Cisco Cloud Control][29]
[AI Canvas London Network Troubleshooting results]

### Enterprise operations at agentic AI speed

Move beyond visibility to autonomous operations with trusted, policy-bound agents that execute
complex workflows at machine speed—while humans govern intent, policy, and risk.

[Discover AI Canvas][30]
[AI networking]

### Resilient, high-speed AI networking

AI-optimized networking that unifies scale, speed, and resilience—so AI workloads run faster, more
efficiently, and at global scale.

[See what's new][31]
[Cisco Silicon One processor on a circuit board in shades of blue and grey]

### Silicon to power AI-scale networking

Purpose-built programmable silicon powers networks with leading performance, efficiency, and scale –
optimized for AI workloads across hyperscalers, service providers, enterprises, and data centers.

[Explore Silicon One][32]
[Sunset over a city skyline with a dense network of glowing lights across the foreground]

### Distributed, optimized enforcement

Deliver zero-trust segmentation and application protection with a highly-distributed security fabric
and unified management across data center, cloud, campus, and IoT environments.

[Explore Hybrid Mesh Firewall][33]
[Close-up of networking equipment with multiple ports and visible Cisco logo]

### Security fused into the network

Security is embedded at every layer of the network, scaling to support any AI application while
simplifying even the most sophisticated campus and enterprise environment.

[Learn about Smart Switches][34]
[Close-up of networking equipment featuring Ethernet ports, status LEDs, and network icons]

### The AI-ready platform the edge demands

Redefine edge computing with a full-stack platform that delivers data center performance,
modularity, centralized management, and built-in security where you need it most.

[See the future of the edge][35]
[Cisco IQ Assets Overview dashboard featuring a total assets count, coverage percentage, and AI
Assistant messages]

### Cisco IQ

Cisco IQ is the unified AI-powered experience that delivers real-time insights, assessments,
troubleshooting, learning, automation, and agent-driven guidance to power Cisco support and
professional services.

[Learn about Cisco IQ][36]
[glow background]

Hosted desktop solutions by Apps4Rent simplify your organization’s transition to the cloud. Our
virtual desktops help you move your data and applications safely, securely, and without disruptions
to existing workflows from your on-premises servers to the cloud. Now you can access your digital
assets anytime, from anywhere, with your favorite internet enabled device. Empower your employees
with powerful tools and software hosted on cloud desktops, including applications and services in
the Microsoft 365 Apps productivity suite that you can optionally add to your subscription. Choose
from a host of virtualization technologies, including the state-of-the-art Microsoft Windows Virtual
Desktop. Regardless of the plan you choose, you can rest assured of 24/7 phone, chat, and email
support from Apps4Rent.

As a fully managed solution, Apps4Rent Cloud Hosted Desktop is a ready-to-use product. However, it
is designed for simplifying management for admins and provide an optimal user experience.

### Works on Tablets/Smartphones

You can access Apps4Rent Virtual Desktop using a range of physical devices including Chromebooks,
netbooks, and ultrabooks books, iPads, and Android tablets, Linux, Windows, or Mac machines.

### Thin/ Dedicated Client Support

You can use a range of client applications to access Apps4Rent Virtual Desktop. These can be
installed on corresponding devices either by admins with central control or even by users without
admin rights.

### Access via Internet Browser

All you need for using the Apps4Rent Cloud Hosted Desktop are an internet connection and a web
browser. The Virtual Desktop cloud solution works with both cable modem and 3G/4G wireless
connections.

  Fognigma doesn’t limit your deployment options to specific providers or data centers. Our

  rather than specialized contractor spaces catered to specific markets that could be targeted.
  
  ### Bring Your Own Device
  
  Fognigma provides virtualized mobile and desktop environments and offers a variety of ways to
  integrate existing physical devices and infrastructure—even without requiring the installation of
  software.
* ### Data Ownership
  
  Fognigma’s design model means your data remains yours, no contractor access or involvement.
  
  ### Reduced Attack Surface
  
  Fognigma’s automation enables networks to be destroyed and regenerated regularly on new IPs,
  without data loss, to prevent observation and detection.
  
  ### Scaling
  
  Automation and scheduling enable rapid scaling to ensure uptime during operational hours and
  reduce cost during downtime.

WHAT AGENTS GET

## One gateway. Every data source. Full control.

Agents access the data they need. You control what they can do. No per-protocol setup. No rule sets
to maintain per data source.

Data Masking

Agents reach sensitive data without seeing what they should not. PII, credentials, and financial
records masked at the wire before the agent processes the response. No schema changes. No
application rewrites. Agents get the data. Humans get the redactions.

[Learn more →][9]
Guardrails

Agents operate with guardrails, not handcuffs. Destructive commands blocked at the gateway before
execution. The agent keeps working on everything it is allowed to do. Security teams find out from
reports, not incidents.

[Learn more →][10]
AI Analysis

Every agent session is classified by risk automatically. Anomalous access patterns are flagged
before they become incidents. You see what agents are actually doing across production, not what
logs approximate.

[Learn more →][11]
Command Approval

High-risk agent actions pause for human review. Approval in Slack, ticket in Jira, escalation in
Teams. Agents stay unblocked on everything else. No one watches a dashboard at 3 AM.

[Learn more →][12]

“Developers got autonomy. Security got auditability. We stopped choosing between the two.”

[EBANX]

HOW IT WORKS IN PRACTICE

## Agents that can reach anything. Zero incidents.

The Blocked Use Case

The head of AI wants agents querying the transaction database. Compliance says no. The data is too
sensitive. Hoop deploys in front of the database. PII is masked at the wire. The agent gets the data
it needs. Compliance gets the audit trail. The project ships.

The AI Agent

An AI agent queried production. Sensitive fields were masked before the agent processed the
response. A destructive command was blocked at the gateway. The agent kept working on everything it
was allowed to do. The security team found out from the weekly report, not a 3 AM page.

The MCP Problem

Twelve data sources. Twelve MCP gateways. Twelve rule sets to maintain. One legacy protocol MCP does
not support. Hoop replaces all of it. One gateway, transparent at the wire, one rule set that covers
every protocol. Oracle included.

“Zero setup for GDPR, SOC2, and PCI across our databases, Kubernetes clusters, and AWS accounts. We
replaced our in-house tool in a week.”

[RD Station]

“Manual financial operations were our biggest bottleneck. Hoop automated access, eliminated human
error, and gave us audit trails that are regulator-ready in real time.”

##### Visibility & Reporting

Organizations often struggle to gain visibility into license counts, usage, renewal dates, and
costs. Finance departments may receive bills without a clear understanding of what they are being
charged for. Our system provides simple tools to help you prevent overages and provide valuable
oversight.

Many IT and finance professionals lack knowledge about which licenses are actively used and how
various apps and services are consumed. MSP Hub will help you make sure you minimize license waste
and maximize your license investment.

Creating a single platform to serve the license management and procurement needs of your entire
organization was our goal…and we nailed it. Your Procurement, Finance, and IT teams can now do/find
what they need in a single platform available anytime, anywhere.

Procuring software licenses at scale can be challenging. Whether you’re buying and managing a dozen
licenses or ten thousand, our tools will help make the ordering and provisioning process quick,
smooth, and simple.

## We care about nature and its limited resources

Traditional AI factories consume vast resources

### Water Consumption

Uses up to 1.5M - 3M m3 of water annually for evaporative cooling.

### Cooling liquid

Often uses Glycols, PFAS, or chemical biocides that require hazardous disposal.

### Energy Source

Primarily powered by coal, gas, and intermittent renewables.

### Carbon Footprint

Dependent on the local grid's fossil fuel mix.

virtual desktops help you move your data and applications safely, securely, and without disruptions

assets anytime, from anywhere, with your favorite internet enabled device. Empower your employees
with powerful tools and software hosted on cloud desktops, including applications and services in
the Microsoft 365 Apps productivity suite that you can optionally add to your subscription. Choose

support from Apps4Rent.

Simplifying complexity with smart, practical solutions.

is designed for simplifying management for admins and provide an optimal user experience.

You can access Apps4Rent Virtual Desktop using a range of physical devices including Chromebooks,
netbooks, and ultrabooks books, iPads, and Android tablets, Linux, Windows, or Mac machines.

You can use a range of client applications to access Apps4Rent Virtual Desktop. These can be
installed on corresponding devices either by admins with central control or even by users without
admin rights.

### Access via Internet Browser

All you need for using the Apps4Rent Cloud Hosted Desktop are an internet connection and a web
browser. The Virtual Desktop cloud solution works with both cable modem and 3G/4G wireless
connections.

Confidence in every connection, every time

Users have full rights to files and applications on Apps4Rent Cloud Desktop. You can access, manage,
modify, and transfer any data on your instance as per your requirements.

With Apps4Rent Cloud Hosted Desktop, organizations can manage the solution with powerful
administrative control and security features for application access.

### Use Local Devices/Printers

Most local devices, such as printers and other USB peripherals can be configured to work with
Apps4Rent Cloud Desktop provided they are supported by the Operating System.

### Office + Free Applications

## Unlike Any Other

With 50+ patents issued across the Fognigma product line, Fognigma is committed to constant

* ### Infrastructure Control
  
  Fognigma doesn’t limit your deployment options to specific providers or data centers. Our
  multi-cloud approach ensures your networks are hidden in the vastly used commercial cloud space,
  rather than specialized contractor spaces catered to specific markets that could be targeted.
  
  ### Bring Your Own Device
  
  Fognigma provides virtualized mobile and desktop environments and offers a variety of ways to
  integrate existing physical devices and infrastructure—even without requiring the installation of
  software.
* ### Data Ownership
  
  Fognigma’s design model means your data remains yours, no contractor access or involvement.
  
  ### Reduced Attack Surface
  
  Fognigma’s automation enables networks to be destroyed and regenerated regularly on new IPs,
  without data loss, to prevent observation and detection.
  
  ### Scaling
  
  Automation and scheduling enable rapid scaling to ensure uptime during operational hours and
  reduce cost during downtime.

* Connect through a Remote Desktop Gateway.
* Simplified management of your connections and credentials from the Connection Center, including a

* Audio and video streaming.
* Redirect folders, your clipboard, and local devices such as microphones and cameras.
* Teams Media Optimization.
* Support for multiple monitors.

## We care about nature and its limited resources

Traditional AI factories consume vast resources

### Water Consumption

Uses up to 1.5M - 3M m3 of water annually for evaporative cooling.

### Cooling liquid

Often uses Glycols, PFAS, or chemical biocides that require hazardous disposal.

### Energy Source

Primarily powered by coal, gas, and intermittent renewables.

### Carbon Footprint

Dependent on the local grid's fossil fuel mix.

Align AI factories with modular nuclear power to cut emissions for large-scale AI.

Optimize GPU density, cooling, and power distribution to boost output at less cost.

Align AI factories with regional grids, regulations, and communities.

### Better building

Extend lifecycles and minimize waste with modular factories and repeatable builds.
